notes.title: The End of an Actress released on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just thought I'd let you know that my newest VN, The End of an Actress, has been released on Steam!
It's a tragic romance story based loosely on the life (and death) of Marie Antoinette. It has a few different endings, but none of them are particularly cheerful.

In tone, I feel like it's similar-ish to Empty Horizons, so if you enjoyed one you might enjoy the other.

If you're interested, I hope you consider checking it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147760/The_End_of_an_Actress/

Thank you very much!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Just updating this game to let everybody know that this VN has been updated, and is now playable in Russian!

I also fixed a handful of typos in the English version, so if anybody owns this VN but hasn't played it yet, now would be a good time! ☆彡

notes.title: New VN on Steam
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I've released a new visual novel on Steam with artwork by SillySelly (the same artist as Empty Horizons). If you're fond of her artwork, please check it out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/628460/Lily_of_the_Valley/

Lily is a short, gloomy story about a young man who meets a mysterious young girl. Set in Wales, its main themes are: the importance of family, the inevitability of death, and the deliciousness of doughnuts.

Given it's a short VN, it can be purchased for $2.99. I hope you enjoy it!

- ebi x

notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I just uploaded a new build for this VN! It has a few differences from the previous version, including:

- two improved backgrounds
- new, cleaner SFX (particularly for the ambient sounds, like the chirping birds and the car engine)
- transitions between sprite pose changes
- some minor grammatical tweaks

If anybody happens to find any spelling errors, or any other issues in the build, you can leave it in the reply to this post and I will try to fix up any problems ASAP.

- ebi x

notes.title: This World Unknown Released
notes.content:
My newest visual novel, This World Unknown, has been released on Steam!
Though maybe 'newest' is not the correct term, since it's been in development for a long time, and in fact is more than twice the age of Empty Horizons...

This World Unknown is a long fantasy otome game. If you liked Empty Horizons, but wished there were a few more guys to choose from, then TWU has you covered, because there are four love interests with different routes!

TWU is also a bit more like a standard otome game than EH, and there is more actual romance. It's sappier.

You can check it out here, if you are so inclined:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/521540

- Ebi x

notes.title: This World Unknown on Steam Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi guys u///u

I have a brand new VN on Steam Greenlight that you can vote for if you are so interested! It's a very long VN that took about 2 years to make, and the process was somewhat hellish... but I survived, and it's all finished now! I just need your help!

While I loosely classify Empty Horizons as an otome VN, I think its status as an 'otome game' can be questioned, given there isn't all that much romance. If you're into otome VNs, This World Unknown will probably be more appealing to you, because it has far more qualities akin with a typical otome VN, including a lot more romance and four male love interests!

If you're interested, you can vote 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=740215243]here [/url] , or check out the demo [url=https://sekaiproject.com/This-World-Unknown-Demo-1.0-all.zip]here[/url] or [url=https://ebihime.itch.io/this-world-unknown]here![/url]

- Ebi xxx
